name: everything-codex-code
description: Codex marketplace bundle for the generated aggregate ECC workflow projection built from the selected superpowers-ecc surface.
rights: Harley-authored plugin shell with third-party ECC-derived skill projections mirrored from the existing superpowers-ecc marketplace surface. Each skill carries its own source author, source license, and projection notes in SOURCE.md, references/source-map.md, and references/bundle-manifest.json.

interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin bundle that projects the selected ECC Superpowers-style workflow skills already selected in superpowers-ecc into a second generated installable marketplace pack.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the Everything Codex Code bundle and source map.
Use the pack to review the selected ECC workflow skills and their source map.
Compare the bundle against the retained ECC custody surfaces and the superpowers-ecc marketplace projection.
